overall_limitations: Several rubric entries are only partially stated or distributed across claims; individual claims do not receive complete-entry credit merely because their combined coverage would suffice.
The packet does not establish the anonymous output's inventory-based novelty judgments, numerical selection scores, or conceptual saturation.
